text:
Bhai, order ORD-22007 (winter jacket) ka status abhi bhi "out_for_delivery" dikha raha hai aur iske delivery partner Shadowfax hain. 

Aapko poora din ghar pe wait karna pada, iske liye sorry. Lagta hai delivery agent kisi wajah se late ho gaya hai ya aaj cover nahi kar paya. 

Kya aap chahte hain ki main iski delivery ke liye escalation raise kar doon, ya phir aap kisi human agent se baat karna chahenge?
